title: Making a cigar-box guitar and teaching himself
summary: Lewis began at 10 or 11 with a homemade cigar-box guitar and learned by ear with no teacher.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up a first guitar or banjo, self-taught

blocks.x: When did you start playing music?

Oh, I started playing music, I guess, when I was about 10 or 11 years old, I made my own guitar out of a cigar box. You know, it started, it's like you take a cigar box, cut a little hole in there, and take a little piece of wood nail on there with a tack, and take some nails and put it in the end of that like a tune of guitar, and bend the nails and take stream wire. Mm-hmm. You know, that's the way I did, that's why I started out, just playing that away. And they didn't have nobody knew music, teaching nothing. That's the only way I learned my own self in there. If I go anywhere and hear somebody else play anything, I go home and play the same thing after I get home. Mm-hmm.
